summary: Iteration 11: Full backend + frontend verification of Client Portal 'Payment SO' and 'Wage Report' features. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_client_portal_iter11.py with 14 pytest cases — all PASS. Verified GET /api/portal/payments returns only Acme Officer (total 650.00, grand_total 650.00) with no Globex leakage; officer detail 200 for Acme, 404 for Globex; PDF & XLSX report streams valid (magic bytes %PDF / PK); /api/portal/wage-report Aug 2026 returns Acme Officer 8h / 80.00 (defaults to current month when no range provided); payslip PDF/XLSX downloads succeed; payslip for Globex officer → 404. Role gates confirmed: admin → 403 on /portal/payments, /portal/wage-report, /portal/payments/report/pdf; client → 403 on /so-payments/*. All 26 prior regression tests (test_client_portal.py + test_client_portal_iter10.py) also PASS. Frontend (Playwright, viewport 1920×1080): logged in as acme@client.com; sidebar exposes client-nav-payment-so and client-nav-wage-report; Payment SO page renders the single Acme row with W2 500.00, W9 total 150.00, total 650.00, entries 1; totals footer matches; PDF & XLSX buttons trigger actual file downloads (Payments.pdf/.xlsx). Clicking View opens payment-detail dialog showing dated W2/W9 DD/W9 Zelle rows summing to 650.00, and both payment-officer-pdf/xlsx downloads succeed. Globex officer never appears in list or detail. Wage Report defaults to current-month range; setting range 2026-08-01..2026-08-31 + Refresh shows only Acme Officer, 1 shift, 1 completed, 8 hours, wage ৳80.00 (currency symbol ৳ correctly applied via AppSettings); payslip-pdf-<id> and payslip-xlsx-<id> both download files (Payslip-Acme-Officer.pdf/.xlsx). Data isolation is enforced on both API and UI layers.
critical_code_review_comments: client_portal.py: /portal/payments and /portal/payments/officer/{id} correctly delegate to so_payments _client_context/_officer_context and enforce officer ownership via _own_officer -> 404 for foreign officer. Cannot enumerate other clients' officer IDs.

/portal/wage-report aggregation correctly filters by client_id and excludes SPECIAL_OFFICERS (TEMP/OPEN_SHIFT); wage math uses duty_hours*duty_rate only for COMPLETED_STATUSES — matches expected 8h*10=80.
portal_wage_report writes officer_code twice (line 583 & 584) — harmless but redundant; the second overwrites the first. Consider removing the first assignment for clarity.

/portal/officers/{id}/payslip enforces ownership before generating PDF/XLSX. Financial rate ends up visible in payslip (rate column) which is intentional for the wage report use-case, but note this is the only place duty_rate is exposed to the client — acceptable per feature spec.
Frontend ClientPaymentSO/ClientWageReport correctly use api (with credentials) for blob downloads via same-origin cookies; error handling with toast on failure present.
Currency symbol read from AppSettings and applied consistently (৳ in tests). Good.
Minor: ClientPaymentSO row key uses officer_id which is fine; no pagination — capped implicitly by so_payments _client_context (should confirm it does not exceed reasonable limits at scale).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded Acme Officer (W2 500 + W9 DD 100 + W9 Zelle 50 = 650) and Aug 2026 8h shift (rate 10 => wage 80). No test data left behind.
